maddeler.e:
ينتقدون (form VIII)
# يَنْتَقِدُونَ (yantaqidūna) /jan.ta.qi.duː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَقَدَ (intaqada)
# يُنْتَقَدُونَ (yuntaqadūna) /jun.ta.qa.duː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَقَدَ (intaqada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
